summary: Biophytis S.A., a clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing its audited 2025 parent-company financial statements and the resumption of trading on Euronext Growth Paris. The statutory auditors issued a qualified report, citing going-concern uncertainty and accounting treatment of capital transactions. The filing details a net loss of €8.2 million for 2025 (improved from €9.4 million in 2024) and reduced financial debt of €11.9 million. This is a routine financial reporting and trading resumption notice, not a special situation transaction.
